name: query_tenant_metrics
description: Return a single named metric for the caller's tenant from a fixed registry (fact_count, active_count, disputed_count, superseded_count, retracted_count, event_count, supersede_rate, dispute_rate). Enumerated metrics only; no caller-supplied SQL or free-form aggregation.

tenant_id.description: Tenant to report on (requested data scope). The Gateway governance layer authorizes whether the caller may select it.

metric.description: The named metric to compute. One of: fact_count|active_count|disputed_count|superseded_count|retracted_count|event_count|supersede_rate|dispute_rate (enum moved to description per AgentCore SchemaDefinition; enforced server-side by the metric registry — unknown metrics are rejected with the allowed list).
